verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only inbound migration: importing subscriptions from Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, or Chargebee, the migration toolkit, and migrating data into Stripe. Nothing documents exporting subscriptions, invoices, or usage records, or porting stored payment methods out to another provider. The Subscriptions API is at most a developer building block, not a documented export or portability capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave
